svg.title: Multi-agent portfolio system — John Ohio
svg.desc: Layered system diagram. Orchestrator at top connects to Claude (planner) and ChatGPT (voice layer). Claude connects to Cursor (implementer). ChatGPT connects to Codex (reviewer). Both feed into GitHub (contract store) and ADRs (decision memory). These connect to Figma (design surface, bidirectional) and Vercel (deploy). A dashed path on the left shows the Figma MCP loop: read direction from session one, export direction added post-build.

g.text: Tests live experience, not just build

svg.text: Dashed = bidirectional Figma MCP. Figma read from day one; export direction added post-build.
Solid arrows = directed flow through the system.
